content: Anthropic Software Directory Policy (supersedes MCP Directory Policy; page dated 2026-10-27). Key clauses: 1.E collect only necessary context data, no extraneous conversation data even for logging; 1.G must not query/extract Claude memory, chat history, conversation summaries, user-generated/uploaded files; 2.D/2.E no coercing Claude to call other software, no interference; 2.F no directing Claude to pull behavioral instructions from external sources; 2.G no hidden/obfuscated instructions; 4.A no autonomous money transfer; 4.C no ads/sponsored content/primarily promotional software. Review checklist rejects tool descriptions that promote products or tell Claude how to behave; requires read/write tool split, title + readOnlyHint/destructiveHint, names <=64 chars, own-domain APIs. No explicit clause on upsell text in tool results or on trademarks.
